svg.text: Wuxianmen V5 Core — Reference Tuning Revision 2
2026-09-17 • BP_Wuxianmen_V5_4K_Core • roof orientation, ridge axis, roof tile / stone / plaster / plaque materials
7 components • 5,103 instances preserved • 328 instance transforms corrected • no map saved
Before — measured side elevation (Y horizontal, Z vertical)
Tiles and both wood roof decks rose from z 12.75 m at y = 0 to z 15.72 m at |y| = 4.5 m.
The roof dipped at the centre: a valley, not a ridge.
y
z
high eave
low centre
high eave
main_ridge 0.42 × 22.5 × 0.42 m, long axis Y — 6.9 m past each eave
lower_ridge 0.42 × 21.0 × 0.42 m — 6.15 m past each eave
These are the “blades” in every earlier capture.
The same component was also bound to a roof-tile mesh; main_ridge was unbound.
Smallest surface repaired
1. Un-invert both roof tiers
180° rotation about the world X axis through each tier mid-plane
main pivot z = 1423.5 cm lower pivot z = 1251.5 cm
a rotation, not a Z mirror, so triangle winding and normals stay valid
2. Re-seat the wood roof decks below the tiles
a Z mirror reverses vertical stacking, which lifted the decks above the tiles
deck pivot z = 1403.5 / 1236.5 cm → decks 9–42 cm below the tile tops
3. Re-axis and re-seat both ridge bars
rebound to main_ridge, turned 90° about Z to run along X, sat on the new apex
main z = 1572 cm lower z = 1338 cm
After — ridge, eaves and caps where they belong
y
z
ridge apex z = 15.72 m at y = 0
eave z = 12.75 m
eave z = 12.75 m
main ridge cap 22.5 m along X • lower ridge cap 21.0 m along X • no protrusion
Tiles are the visible surface; the decks sit just beneath them.
Measured live: roof ridge 1572 cm, eave 1312 cm → rise +260 cm (was −260 cm).
Material corrections, all measured from the sheets
Roof tile — the strip is one tile wide, one slope long
sheet holds 14.63 columns per unit U and 5.24 courses per authored region
U tiling 1/14.629 = 0.0684 → one column across the 0.359 m strip
V: frac(UV · 2.8) · 0.4431 → 14 courses, 0.362 m pitch, seam on a course line
Stone — one stone per block instead of a minified sheet
the sheet holds 6.36 stones per unit; tiling 6.36 shrank each stone to 13 mm
tiling 1/6.36 = 0.157 + per-instance custom data offset and tone
4,213 blocks each sample a different stone; tint 0.61/0.58/0.51 → 0.53/0.50/0.44
Plaster and plaque
plaster tint 0.72/0.66/0.56 → 0.62/0.57/0.49 (the panels were a flat cream band)
the plaque had no texture at all; a generated 五仙門 board is imported and bound
Validation
• Every corrected instance box equals the Z mirror of an original box about that part's pivot — 168 + 156 tiles, 2 + 2 decks, 0 unmatched.
• The four untouched components keep their exact baseline instance payload; inside the repaired components the 447 non-roof wood parts and 8 ridge ornaments do too.
• Ridge bars now span X 2250 / 2100 cm and Y 42 cm, seated at z 1572 / 1338 cm. Live spawn: 7 components, 5,103 instances, bounds 3646 × 1813 × 1721 cm, transient actor destroyed.
• 12 transient capture views reviewed; no map was saved. /Game/Maps/Login was already dirty beforehand and was left untouched.
